service_profile.service_description: Mobile kitchen trailer rental for restaurant continuity during phased renovation. A profile for operators managing a staged remodel where different kitchen functions move in and out of service over time.

cooking: For restaurant continuity during phased renovation, each kitchen includes a stove, oven, and essential cooking utensils to support phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel. Additional equipment options are available through 24/7 support.
refrigeration: For restaurant continuity during phased renovation, a separate temporary mobile refrigerator trailer can support phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel. Pricing is 20 ft $2,452, 25 ft $2,952, 30 ft $3,452, 35 ft $3,952, and 40 ft $4,452. These are site-wide starting estimates after the site adjustment; city ETA discounts do not apply to refrigerator trailer pricing. Capacity, configuration, and availability are handled through 24/7 support.
preparation: To support phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel, preparation areas and requested equipment are reviewed before delivery for sanitation, functionality, site fit, and readiness. Additional equipment may be rented as needed for a site serving restaurants and hotels, including access items such as stairs and ramps. The same preparation, equipment, and sanitation checks are repeated during off-rent maintenance.
sanitation: For restaurant continuity during phased renovation, every kitchen facility follows a sanitation plan before delivery, after the rental, and while the trailer is off rent for maintenance. The plan covers food-contact areas, sanitation-related connections, condition records, and readiness for the next dispatch.
storage: Storage needs for phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel can be reviewed with the selected kitchen configuration. Dry or cold storage options are available based on site requirements and the approved equipment package.
utilities: For restaurant continuity during phased renovation, the site is reviewed before delivery for approved power capacity and connection type, potable water supply, wastewater or gray-water drainage, fuel or gas requirements where applicable, ventilation clearances, trailer placement, access, stairs or ramps, and any required permits or inspections. Requirements depend on the trailer configuration and site conditions and are verified with the company before dispatch.

preparation_plan.purpose: Prepare each mobile kitchen facility and requested supporting equipment for restaurants and hotels managing phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel, then keep it deployment-ready between rentals.
before_delivery: Clean and sanitize preparation surfaces and related food-contact areas.
Check preparation equipment and connected systems for functionality before dispatch.

Review the restaurants and hotels request and site conditions to prepare the approved configuration for phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel, along with any requested additional equipment.
Review whether access equipment such as stairs, ramps, or other site-support items is needed and available for rental.
during_off_rent_maintenance: Recheck preparation equipment and related components for functionality while the trailer is off rent between restaurant continuity during phased renovation assignments.
Repeat sanitation and condition checks for preparation areas and supporting equipment used for phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel.
Document service needs, complete approved maintenance, and verify the configuration is ready for the next restaurant continuity during phased renovation assignment.
preparation_plan.additional_equipment_note: Additional equipment for restaurant continuity during phased renovation is subject to request, site requirements, availability, and company approval. Examples may include stairs, ramps, and other access or site-support equipment.

utilities_plan.power: For restaurant continuity during phased renovation, verify the approved power source, capacity, connection type, and connection location for the selected trailer configuration.
utilities_plan.water_supply: For phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel, verify a potable water source, required pressure or flow, hose connection, and availability at the placement area.
utilities_plan.wastewater: For a restaurant continuity during phased renovation deployment, verify the gray-water drainage, holding-tank, pump, or disposal method required for the selected configuration and site.
utilities_plan.fuel: For the equipment package selected for restaurants and hotels and phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel, verify propane, natural gas, or other approved fuel requirements where applicable.
utilities_plan.ventilation: Before supporting phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel, verify ventilation, exhaust, clearance, and placement requirements for the trailer and selected equipment.
utilities_plan.site_access: For a restaurant continuity during phased renovation site, verify a suitable placement area, delivery access, clearances, level conditions, stairs, ramps, and other access needs.
utilities_plan.approvals: For restaurant continuity during phased renovation, verify permits, inspections, local code requirements, and utility coordination before delivery where applicable.
utilities_plan.pre_delivery_check: Before dispatch for phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel, verify that required connections, access, approvals, and site preparations are ready.
utilities_plan.confirmation_note: Exact utility specifications for restaurant continuity during phased renovation depend on the trailer configuration and site conditions and are verified with the company before dispatch.

sanitation_plan.purpose: Maintain a clean, safe, and deployment-ready kitchen facility throughout the rental lifecycle for restaurant continuity during phased renovation.
before_delivery: Clean and sanitize food-contact surfaces, cooking areas, preparation areas, dishwashing areas, and refrigeration interiors.
Check sanitation-related water, drainage, waste, and connection points before dispatch.
Document the trailer condition and verify that the facility is ready for phased kitchen renovation and section-by-section remodel delivery and setup.
after_rental: After the restaurant continuity during phased renovation rental, remove food, waste, and customer-supplied materials from the facility.
Clean and sanitize cooking, preparation, dishwashing, storage, and refrigeration areas after return or pickup.
Inspect the facility, document cleaning and condition findings, and record any repair or service needs before the trailer is released.
off_rent_maintenance: Keep the trailer in a clean and sanitary condition while it is off rent between restaurant continuity during phased renovation assignments.
Complete scheduled inspection and maintenance of kitchen, dishwasher, refrigerator, water, drainage, and related operating components.
Resolve documented service items and verify sanitation readiness before the trailer is assigned to the next restaurant continuity during phased renovation rental.
sanitation_plan.confirmation_note: Final sanitation, inspection, and maintenance records for restaurant continuity during phased renovation should be verified through company operations before delivery and before the next rental assignment.

rental_options.extension_policy: Rental extensions may be requested before the scheduled return date and are subject to trailer availability, continued site suitability, and company approval. Any revised rental period, pricing, delivery or relocation costs, and return arrangements must be approved before the extension becomes effective.
rental_options.relocation_policy: Relocation requests must be submitted before the trailer is moved and are subject to company approval, route and access review, site suitability, utility disconnection and reconnection requirements, availability, and any applicable transport, setup, or relocation charges. The trailer must not be moved without prior company approval.

pricing.minimum_rental: Minimum rental pricing follows the selected kitchen size: 20 ft $5,952, 25 ft $6,452, 30 ft $6,952, 35 ft $7,452, and 40 ft $7,952. These are site-wide starting prices before any location-specific quote adjustments; the applicable rental term and final quote are provided with the company quote.

city_discount_policy.rule: Lowest numeric ETA receives the highest discount; discount decreases linearly with ETA and is rounded to one decimal percent.

temporary_refrigerator_trailer.pricing_basis: Site-wide refrigerator trailer pricing after the site adjustment; no city ETA discount applied.

delivery.availability_fallback: If the nearest approved inventory is unavailable, another approved service location may be used and the ETA may change.

faqs.question: Can a trailer support a phased kitchen remodel?
faqs.answer: It can be evaluated when each phase's offline functions, menu, volume, utilities, access, and dates are documented.

faqs.question: Can the configuration change between phases?
faqs.answer: Changes depend on inventory, site limits, schedule, and company approval.

faqs.question: How should the rental term include commissioning?
faqs.answer: Include testing and transition time after each permanent function is ready; exact terms require confirmation.

faqs.question: Can some permanent kitchen functions remain in use?
faqs.answer: A split workflow may be possible when access, sanitation, utilities, and responsibilities are clearly planned.

faqs.question: What information should the contractor provide?
faqs.answer: Provide milestone dates, work zones, access route, utility plan, placement, and site contact.

faqs.question: Can the trailer leave before the remodel is fully complete?
faqs.answer: Pickup should follow the last supported function's return and an agreed transition plan.
